title: The rise of small bites: how mini desserts changed modern hosting

excerpt: From classic Gâteau Cupcakes—served plain or crowned with real-vanilla fresh cream—to two-layer Brownie Basque Cupcakes and glazed Lemon Cakes, why single-serve bakes are reshaping Sydney celebrations.
